metadata.description: Skills, hooks and small tools for Claude Code.

plugins.name: peers
plugins.description: A local web page of the Claude Code sessions on this machine: which are working, waiting on you or idle, what each has claimed, and who messaged whom.

plugins.name: stacked-pr-guard
plugins.description: Blocks deleting a branch that open pull requests are based on, so GitHub doesn't close the PRs stacked on it.

plugins.name: codebase-audit
plugins.description: A full critical review of a codebase or component, with severity-rated findings checked against current best practice and filed as GitHub issues once you confirm.

plugins.name: disk-cleanup-inventory
plugins.description: A tiered inventory of what is using disk space, delivered as a checklist worksheet; deletes only what you tick.

plugins.name: downloads-tidy
plugins.description: Files and declutters ~/Downloads against your own filing rules and existing folders, leaving it flat.

plugins.name: ec2-spinup
plugins.description: Starts a small, tagged, self-terminating EC2 worker in a chosen region, with instance-profile auth and IP-restricted SSH.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a kickoff prompt so a new Claude session inherits this one's goal, sources, settled decisions and risks.

plugins.name: human-handoff
plugins.description: Packages finished work for a human collaborator and drafts the covering note; sends only on your word.

plugins.name: residue-sweep
plugins.description: Removes development residue (history-narrating comments, stale names, dead code, doc drift) without changing behavior.

plugins.name: speaker-prep
plugins.description: Turns a deck or brief into talking points or a timed script, with print-ready PDFs.
